title: Does density deserve priority in the first selected service?
statement: In a preregistered service, an intervention increasing usable installed-system energy density improves the binding constraint more than the best feasible non-density alternative without violating agreed safeguards.

scope.missing_reason: The first framing audit must select and register a bounded case.

mechanism: A storage mass or volume constraint may limit the delivered service. Whether it binds is to be investigated.
assumptions: The selected service can be compared at fixed quality and reliability.
Comparable lifecycle data and feasible alternatives can be obtained.
falsifier: Within the registered scope, density fails the minimum improvement threshold, violates a hard constraint, or is robustly dominated by a feasible comparator. Missing or incomparable evidence leaves the claim unresolved.

confidence.basis: No study completed; no calibrated probability.

confidence_history.reason: Service, thresholds and comparisons remain unregistered.

unknown_unknown_exposure: Unrepresented affected groups, excluded supply chains and changes in service demand.
safety: Desk research only in the initial audit. Any hazardous physical work requires qualified professional review.
